description: This is a Java test class for the HibernateConceptDAO, containing unit tests for CRUD operations, querying, and business logic validations related to concepts and drugs in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: HibernateConceptDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernateConceptDAO testing various concept and drug related data retrieval and validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, setting up datasets and updating the search index.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIf_eitherDrugNameOrConceptNameMatchesThePhaseNotBoth
methods.description: Tests that the DAO returns drugs matching either the drug name or the concept name, not both.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDistinctDrugs
methods.description: Ensures that the DAO returns unique drug entries when querying.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIf_EitherDrugNameIsUpperOrLowerCase
methods.description: Verifies that case-insensitive matching works for drug names.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIfPhraseMatchDrugNameNoNeedToMatchBothConceptNameAndDrugName
methods.description: Checks that matching the drug name alone is sufficient, even if the concept name does not match.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIfPhaseMatchConceptNameNoNeedToMatchBothConceptNameAndDrugName
methods.description: Verifies that matching the concept name alone suffices without matching the drug name.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugWhenPhraseMatchDrugNameEvenSerchDrugConceeptNameIsfalse
methods.description: Tests phrase matching for drug names when concept name matching is disabled.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldNotReturnRetired
methods.description: Ensures that retired drugs are excluded from query results.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnNonRetired
methods.description: Ensures non-retired drugs are included in query results.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugEvenIf_DrugNameHasSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies matching of drug names with special characters.

methods.name: shouldGetConceptAttributeCountForAttributeType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of concept attribute counts for a specific attribute type.

methods.name: isConceptNameDuplicate_shouldNotFailIfConceptDoesNotHaveADefaultNameForLocale
methods.description: Validates no exception occurs when checking duplication for concept names without a default name for the locale.

methods.name: getConceptIdsByMapping_shouldReturnDistinctConceptIds
methods.description: Checks that concept IDs returned by mapping queries are unique and correct.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypes_shouldReturnDatatypesWithNameStartingWithGivenString
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of concept datatypes that start with a specific prefix.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypes_shouldReturnEmptyListForNonExistentName
methods.description: Ensures empty list is returned for non-existent datatype prefixes.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangesByConceptId_shouldReturnEmptyListForIfNoConceptReferenceRangeIsLinkedToConcept
methods.description: Checks that an empty list is returned when no reference ranges are associated with a concept.
